scope: Single-source v1 pixel isolation/edge defect inventory only; no animation, root, runtime, ZIP, public, FPS or device approval.

source.purpose: Existing armored Tiger Vanguard draft v1 only, not ordinary tiger or final Boss; no v2 mixing.

measurementPolicy.limits: Large components are machine labels, not authored poses. Whole projection regions retain all pixels; detached fringe-only x runs within two blank columns are included in the nearest unambiguous body region, not masked away. For the merged death pair, tight component boxes are probes only; no ownership assigned to detached fringe, no pixels removed. Alpha<=8 is preserved in source bytes but not certified as a transparent guard.

summary.interpretation: v1 has 32 large source components, not a proven missing death drawing. Alpha>8 x projection merges the final pair because their x extents overlap; alpha>16 separates those x runs. 31 regions must not be called 31 semantic poses. Animation distinctness/quality still require human review.
